name: Frozen Voice
source:
A lonely life and few friends were all Simon had to deal with as usual. Everything he sees as ordinary suddenly gets changed as his long-lost friend comes back with a phone call. Chronic depression and the wicked manifestations of his own mind kept him sleepless until She came. Finally, he finds meaning in his life, and more adventure unfolds on the canvas, with lingering threats lurking deep. He had to put up with whatever paranormal event happened and face the horrors.

[From [url=https://fahimulbarisstudio.itch.io/frozen-voice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Simon像往常一樣過著孤獨的生活，朋友寥寥無幾。他眼中一成不變的日常，隨著失散多年的朋友打來一通電話，突然發生了變化。長期的憂鬱與內心陰暗的幻象讓他徹夜難眠，直到「她」出現。終於，他在生活中找到了意義，畫布上也展開了更多冒險，深處仍潛藏著揮之不去的威脅。他必須面對發生的超自然事件，直面那些恐怖。

[來源：[url=https://fahimulbarisstudio.itch.io/frozen-voice]itch.io[/url]]
